caseNameFull: Osage Tribe of Indians v. Ickes, Secretary of the Interior
attorneys: Messrs. Thomas P. Gore and Leslie C. Gar-nett for petitioners. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Littell, and Messrs. Vernon L. Wilkinson and Roger P. Marquis for Harold L. Ickes, Secretary of the Interior; and Messrs. Roy St. Lewis and Peter Q. Nyce for Tom H. Fraley, County Treasurer, — respondents.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied. Mr. Justice Rutledge took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
